notes.title: picoCAD JAM
notes.content:
In celebration of picoCAD's successful launch on Steam we decided to do official jams again!

The theme for this jam is BUILDING. It's a very open theme so go make whatever you fancy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057634/6f7c22939809d799d2c6b6a6c467cbb065226ee5.gif[/img]
Example by Ben Canfield.

[list]
[*] The jam starts on friday so check out some more info and sign up here: [url=https://itch.io/jam/picocad-jam-144]https://itch.io/jam/picocad-jam-144
[/url][*] The artwork page on the community hub is open now so feel free to upload your works there as well: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2800590/images/]https://steamcommunity.com/app/2800590/images/[/url]
[*] Come hangout in the picoCAD discord to get feedback and show your skills: [url=https://discord.gg/2FwzNRq3Cv]https://discord.gg/2FwzNRq3Cv[/url]
[/list]


Looking forward to see what you all create!
Johan

notes.title: picoCAD tutorial for beginners
notes.content:
[h2]picoCAD is out on Steam! [/h2]

The launch has gone really well with no hiccups or issues. Super stoked that so many people like lowpoly lowres models as much as I do! ☺️

Learning a new software can be difficult but don't worry - we've got your back!

Together with one of the more prolific picoCAD users, Ben Canfield, we've made a tutorial video that covers the basics of modelling in picoCAD. Take a look, it is well worth watching.

[previewyoutube=RMK2VMW05fk;full][/previewyoutube]

If you're eager to learn more, don't hesitate to go to https://picoCAD.net where you can find more tutorials, examples, and resources for your lowpoly builds.

Oh, and one more thing! Please consider giving picoCAD a review here on Steam. It helps a lot with visibility and reaching even more people who love crunchy pixels in 3D.

Al the best,
Johan
